sources.title: Sources & Attribution
sources.intro: Religious content in this app is never invented. Each dataset below has a defined source.
sources.quranTitle: Quran text, translation, tafsir and audio
sources.quranBody: Served through our secure server from the Quran Foundation / Quran.com API. Arabic text uses the API's Uthmani and IndoPak fields directly. Translation and tafsir authors are shown next to the content.
sources.prayerBody: Calculated on-device with the open-source Adhan library using the Umm al-Qura method and the coordinates of Masjid al-Haram and Masjid an-Nabawi. These are calculated times, not the Haram's official announcements.
sources.haramainBody: Imam and Muezzin names for each prayer come from Haramain Schedules (haramainimams.com) and are refreshed every few minutes. Only assignments for today's date are shown; if the source is unavailable or returns invalid data, the app says the schedule cannot be confirmed instead of guessing. Prayer times themselves remain the calculated Umm al-Qura times.
sources.hijriBody: Umm al-Qura calendar via your browser's built-in calendar support.
sources.guidesBody: Compiled from the Quran and hadith collections cited on each item (e.g. Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud). Where scholars differ, the difference is labelled. This content should be reviewed by a qualified scholar before publication.
sources.fontsBody: UI: Inter, Anek Bangla, Noto Sans Bengali, Hind Siliguri, Baloo Da 2, Tiro Bangla, Noto Naskh Arabic, Noto Nastaliq Urdu (SIL Open Font License). Quran: KFGQPC Uthmanic Script Hafs © King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex (distributed unmodified under its free licence); Amiri Quran, Scheherazade New (SIL OFL); IndoPak Al-Qalam font (Al QuranWBW).

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This app is privacy-first. There are no accounts and no advertising.
privacy.localBody: Zikr counts and history, bookmarks, last-read position, favourite duas, Umrah progress and settings stay in your browser storage.
privacy.locationBody: Location is requested only when you use the Qibla feature, is processed on your device and is never sent to our server or any third party.
privacy.networkTitle: What is sent over the network
privacy.networkBody: Requests for Quran pages, translations and tafsir go to our server, which fetches them from the Quran API. No personal data is attached.
privacy.analyticsBody: Analytics are off by default. If enabled, only technical events (page views, errors) are recorded — never which verses you read, which duas you save, or your location.
privacy.notifBody: Notifications are only enabled after you allow them, and can be turned off at any time.
